answer: Require each identity to keep a verifiable delay function chain advancing: a sequential computation that cannot be sped up by parallel hardware, like a tide that only rises on its own schedule. One account means one chain; a hundred fake accounts means a hundred chains, each demanding its own core and wall-clock time. A willow bends but does not multiply, and neither does sequential work: there is no shortcut bridge across the delay, so the cost of every extra identity stays full price instead of being shared.
